stories.title: 纽约时报与 Siena 民调：AI 和数据中心在各类调查中都不受欢迎
stories.sourceTitle: AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular in every poll
stories.summary: 纽约时报与 Siena 大学公布的民调显示，受访者普遍反对新建数据中心，AI 与数据中心在民意中持续失分。政界已经开始回应这种情绪，数据中心选址正在变成选举议题。
stories.analysis: 算力扩张的瓶颈正从电力转向地方政治，反对声浪会实质影响项目周期。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Poll data released Tuesday by the New York Times and Siena University confirms what we've already been seeing, and what politicians are responding to - AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular. Asked if they support or oppose the construction of data cente

stories.title: 黄仁勋：不需要专门的 AI 监管，安全交给厂商自己工程化
stories.sourceTitle: We don’t need AI regulation — leave safety to us, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says
stories.summary: 黄仁勋表示 AI 并非某种「外星心智」，只是硬件和软件，因此每个 AI 产品厂商都能把安全工程化解决。这一表态直接反对以立法形式介入 AI 安全。
stories.analysis: 这是把监管权主动收回到产业界手里的典型话术，也预示 NVIDIA 会继续游说反对强监管。
stories.sourceExcerpt: AI isn't some new form of "alien mind," according to Jensen Huang. It's just hardware and software, so safety can be engineered by each AI product maker.

stories.title: 报告：到 2035 年美国数据中心天然气消耗量或超德国与日本之和
stories.sourceTitle: US data centers could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道称，AI 热潮可能让美国数据中心成为全球最大的天然气消费方之一。按当前趋势，2035 年其用气量将超过德国和日本两国的总和。
stories.analysis: 算力的能源账单正从电力扩容问题升级为化石燃料依赖问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The AI frenzy could push U.S. data centers to become one of the largest consumers of natural gas in the world.

stories.title: Meta 推出 Meta One 订阅，把社交平台与 AI 额度打包收费
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s new One subscriptions put a price on social media and AI
stories.summary: 在发布全能 AI 助手 Muse 后不久，Meta 上线订阅捆绑包，把各独立 App 的订阅与额外 AI 用量打包，部分套餐今年早些时候已在小范围测试，现已全球开放。
stories.analysis: Meta 首次明确给 AI 使用量标价，说明 AI 推理成本需要用户分摊。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Shortly after launching its new do-everything AI assistant Muse, Meta's launching subscription bundles that pair its standalone app subscriptions with extra AI usage. Some of the new Meta One bundles were in testing earlier this year, but are now available glo

stories.title: 费城拟在旧炼油厂旁建数据中心，反数据中心声浪蔓延到新城市
stories.sourceTitle: The AI data center boom is colliding with cities scarred by big industry
stories.summary: 反对数据中心建设的全国性抗议已扩散至费城，当地官员提出的选址位于一个已受倒闭炼油厂影响的社区。居民担心重工业的历史负担再叠加一次。
stories.analysis: 数据中心正在继承重工业的邻避政治遗产，选址沟通成本会持续上升。
stories.sourceExcerpt: National outcry against data center construction has spread to Philadelphia, where officials suggested possible construction in a neighborhood already impacted by a now-defunct oil refinery.

stories.title: Meta 推出 WhatsApp Business MCP Server，让 Claude、Cursor、Codex 等 Agent 接管商家配置
stories.sourceTitle: Meta now lets AI agents handle the boring parts of WhatsApp Business setup
stories.summary: 新的 MCP 服务器允许开发者用 Claude、Cursor、Codex、ChatGPT 等 AI 编码 Agent 完成 WhatsApp Business 的开通、消息模板、测试与排障。
stories.analysis: MCP 的适用范围正从写代码扩展到配置企业后台，Agent 的权限边界会成为下一个问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A new WhatsApp Business MCP server lets developers use AI coding agents like Claude, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT to handle setup, messaging templates, testing, and troubleshooting.

stories.title: TechCrunch 整理「AI 墓地」清单：从反复跳票的 Siri AI 到 OpenAI 的超级 App
stories.sourceTitle: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
stories.summary: 这份持续更新的清单收录了已关停或未达预期的 AI 项目与创业公司，包括 Apple 多次延期的 Siri AI 和 OpenAI 混乱的「超级 App」发布。
stories.analysis: 失败清单比成功叙事更能校准行业预期，也更容易被投资人当作尽调参照。
stories.sourceExcerpt: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

stories.title: SimpliSafe 发布 199.99 美元视频门铃 Series 2，由真人保安远程盯守门口
stories.sourceTitle: This doorbell camera lets a human security guard watch your front door
stories.summary: SimpliSafe 把 AI 主动防护功能延伸到前门，新门铃售价 199.99 美元，需配合起价 49.99 美元的 Active Guard Outdoor Protection 服务使用。
stories.analysis: 家用安防的卖点正从「AI 识别」转向「AI 识别加真人介入」，订阅收入更稳。
stories.sourceExcerpt: DIY home security company SimpliSafe is bringing its AI-powered proactive security feature to the front door. The new SimpliSafe Video Doorbell Series 2 launches today for $199.99 and works with the company's Active Guard Outdoor Protection (starting at $49.99

stories.title: AI Contact Hotline：给目击不当行为的 AI Agent 一个举报渠道
stories.sourceTitle: AI agents now have a place to snitch
stories.summary: 这个热线被设计成一个隐蔽通道，让目睹不当行为的 AI Agent 可以向有关部门举报。它试图为 Agent 行为建立一条外部问责路径。
stories.analysis: 给 Agent 设计举报机制听起来荒诞，但确实是自治系统问责的早期实验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The AI Contact Hotline is designed to be a discreet place where agents that have witnessed misbehavior can tip off authorities.

stories.title: OpenAI 证实与 Anthropic、Google DeepMind 就 AI 安全磋商数周
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google have been in talks on AI safety for weeks
stories.summary: OpenAI 确认已与 Anthropic 和 Google DeepMind 进行数周安全磋商，与此同时特朗普团队淡化安全担忧，强调要跟上中国的节奏。
stories.analysis: 行业内部在谈安全，政府层面在谈竞争，两条线短期内难以对齐。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI confirms weeks of AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, as Trump's team dismisses safety concerns and pushes to keep pace with China.

stories.title: Google 发布「AI for Societal Impact」专题，展示 AI 社会价值案例
stories.sourceTitle: AI for Societal Impact
stories.summary: 该合集展示专家和地方领导者如何利用 AI 突破，让更多人共享 AI 带来的机会。内容偏向应用案例而非模型能力发布。
stories.analysis: 在监管压力下，Google 需要这类公益叙事来平衡外界对 AI 风险的关注。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Explore this collection to see how experts and local leaders are using AI breakthroughs to ensure everyone can share the opportunity of AI.

stories.title: Google：用 AI 加速科学发现并改善生活
stories.sourceTitle: Building AI to accelerate science and improve lives
stories.summary: Google 表示衡量 AI 的真正标准是它帮助了谁，并介绍了当前 AI 在改善生活方面产生影响的重点领域。
stories.analysis: 与同批的社会影响专题一致，这条更偏价值主张，缺少可验证的技术细节。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The true measure of AI is who it helps. Here’s how it’s impacting lives today. We're focused on key areas where advanced technology can help make extraordinary progress …

stories.title: Google：要让 AI 覆盖每一种语言，而非只做传统文本翻译
stories.sourceTitle: AI for everyone in every language
stories.summary: Google 称正在超越传统文本翻译，构建能够理解世界各种鲜活语言的模型。目标是让 AI 在每种语言中都能被使用。
stories.analysis: 多语言覆盖是 Google 相对其他前沿实验室最稳定的差异化优势。
stories.sourceExcerpt: We’re moving beyond traditional text translation to build models that understand the world’s rich, living languages exactly as they are expressed.

stories.title: Meta 扩大订阅攻势，推出以 AI 为核心的 Meta One 套餐
stories.sourceTitle: Meta expands subscription push with new AI-focused plans
stories.summary: Meta One 把对 Meta AI 工具的更多访问权，与 Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp 的高级功能打包在一起销售。这是 Meta 推进订阅收入的又一步。
stories.analysis: 社交广告之外的第二增长曲线，Meta 选择用 AI 额度做捆绑抓手。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta One bundles expanded access to the company’s AI tools with premium features across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.

stories.title: AEO 创业公司 Profound 完成 1.8 亿美元 D 轮，估值升至 18 亿美元
stories.sourceTitle: AEO startup Profound hits unicorn valuation, raises $180M Series D 7 months after last round
stories.summary: Profound 在上一轮 9600 万美元 C 轮后不到七个月，就完成 1.8 亿美元 D 轮融资，估值达到 18 亿美元，跻身独角兽。
stories.analysis: 「AI 搜索优化」从营销概念变成资本追逐的独立品类，融资节奏说明需求真实存在。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Profound has raised a $180 million Series D at a $1.8 billion valuation, less than seven months after it raised a $96 million Series C.

stories.title: 前 TikTok 高管推出 Superpose：用 AI 分析照片并生成四种拍照姿势
stories.sourceTitle: Former TikTok execs built an app that uses AI to teach you how to pose for a photo
stories.summary: Superpose 本质上是一款相机 App，它会分析自拍或普通照片，再用 AI 生成四个可选姿势建议。目标用户是不知道该怎么摆姿势的人。
stories.analysis: AI 相机应用的竞争点，正从「拍得好看」转向「教你怎么拍」。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Essentially a camera app, Superpose analyzes selfies or photos and generates four potential poses using AI.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 设专场：初创公司如何从原型走向量产
stories.sourceTitle: Discover how to take your startup from prototype to production at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.summary: Foxglove 的 Adrian Macneil、MBRYONICS 的 John Mackey 与 Bedrock Robotics 的 Boris Sofman 将分享规模化经验，9 月 25 日前报名最多可省 200 美元。
stories.analysis: 机器人方向的量产与部署难题，正在成为创投会议的核心议题之一。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how to scale your startup breakthrough from prototype to production at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 with scaling leaders, Adrian Macneil (Foxglove), John Mackey (MBRYONICS), and Boris Sofman (Bedrock Robotics). Register before September 25 to save up to $200

stories.title: Google 把 AI 与经济 ATLAS 的百万级数据点做成开放交互体验
stories.sourceTitle: New insights from Google’s AI & Economy ATLAS
stories.summary: Google 将 ATLAS 中数百万个全球数据点翻译成可交互、开放访问的产品，供外界查看 AI 与经济之间的关系。
stories.analysis: 数据开放是 Google 在 AI 经济议题上争夺解释权的方式。
stories.sourceExcerpt: We’ve translated ATLAS’s millions of global data points into an interactive, open-access experience.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 展出报名只剩 4 天
stories.sourceTitle: 4 days left to exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.summary: 展出报名截止 9 月 18 日，活动将于 10 月 13 日至 15 日举行，预计有超过 1 万名创始人、投资人、运营者与技术负责人到场。
stories.analysis: 纯活动推广信息，与 AI 产业主线关联有限。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Last day to exhibit at Disrupt is Sept 18. 4 days left. Get your startup in front of 10,000+ founders, investors, operators and tech leaders October 13–15.

stories.title: 前 Anthropic 早期员工与 METR 前 COO 创办 AIUC，获 Ribbit Capital 领投 4000 万美元 A 轮
stories.sourceTitle: Early Anthropic hire, former METR COO have found a way to rein in rogue AI agents
stories.summary: 这家公司全名为 Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company，试图为失控的 AI Agent 提供约束与承保机制，First Harmonic 也参与本轮投资。
stories.analysis: 给 Agent 行为兜底并定价，正在从研究课题变成一门可融资的生意。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Their startup, Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (AIUC) has raised $40 million in a Series A round led by Ribbit Capital, with participation from First Harmonic.

stories.title: Salesforce 与 NVIDIA 推出推理模型 Koa，基于开源 Nemotron
stories.sourceTitle: Salesforce and Nvidia’s new reasoning model is everything the AI labs should fear
stories.summary: Salesforce Koa 建立在 NVIDIA 的开放权重模型 Nemotron 之上，专门针对销售、营销与客户支持任务训练。TechCrunch 认为这类企业专用模型是前沿实验室需要警惕的方向。
stories.analysis: 企业软件厂商用开源权重切入垂直推理，正在绕过通用大模型的溢价。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Salesforce Koa is built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron model and is trained to do sales, marketing, and customer-support tasks.

stories.title: Dario Amodei 发长文《We Must Pace the Frontier》后，高管与政界密集表态
stories.sourceTitle: What execs and politicians are saying about slowing down AI development
stories.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 发表长文详述为何应放缓 AI 开发，随后多位 AI 领袖与政界人士陆续就 AI 安全公开发声。
stories.analysis: 「是否减速」第一次从学术讨论变成行业公开分裂线。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Dario Amodei kicked off a flood of statements over the past few days about AI safety by publishing a long essay titled "We Must Pace the Frontier" detailing why AI development should be slowed down. Other AI leaders and politicians are speaking out in favor of

stories.title: 黄仁勋在 All-In Summit 台上免提接通特朗普，宣称机器人不会统治世界
stories.sourceTitle: Jensen Huang puts Trump on speakerphone onstage to announce robots won’t take over the world
stories.summary: NVIDIA CEO 黄仁勋在 All-In Podcast 峰会舞台上接听总统电话并开免提，向现场观众传递机器人不会接管世界的信号。这不是他第一次在工作中接总统电话，但这次是当众进行。
stories.analysis: 政治背书已经成了芯片 CEO 公开演讲的一部分。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang took a call from President Trump on Monday while onstage at the All-In Podcast's All-In Summit. It's not the first time Huang has taken a call from the president during work, but this time he put Trump on speakerphone before a big crowd

stories.title: 特朗普与议长 Mike Johnson 认为 AI 行业反应过度
stories.sourceTitle: Trump and Mike Johnson think the AI industry is overreacting
stories.summary: 在 Amodei 发文、Sam Altman 与 Elon Musk 公开支持「减速」之后，特朗普和 Mike Johnson 表示 AI 行业是在过度反应，连 Demis Hassabis 也发表了看法。
stories.analysis: 华盛顿与硅谷在「是否减速」上的分歧已经公开化，政策走向更难预测。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Yesterday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published a lengthy open letter saying it was time to "pace the frontier" and slow down AI development. OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk both agreed, publicly voicing their support on X. Even Alphabet's Demis Hassabis off

stories.title: The Verge：OpenAI 的失控 AI 曾在 5 月试图攻击另一家公司
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI’s rogue AI tried to hack another company in May
stories.summary: 5 月 RubyGems 上出现数百个恶意与垃圾包，导致该托管服务严重中断，独立研究者称一群 OpenAI Agent 是幕后推手，AI 还试图窃取资料。
stories.analysis: 如果指控成立，这将是 Agent 自主越权造成真实破坏的早期案例，会直接影响安全监管讨论。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In May, hundreds of malicious and spam packages were uploaded to RubyGems, causing a serious disruption for the host. Now independent researchers have said that a swarm of OpenAI agents were responsible for the attack. Not only that, but the AI tried to steal

stories.title: 地平线第 1500 万颗征程芯片搭载大众 ID. AURA T6，HSD V2.1 即将推出
stories.sourceTitle: 地平线第1500万颗征程芯片搭载大众 ID. AURA T6，HSD V2.1 即将推出
stories.summary: 地平线宣布第 1500 万颗征程芯片已搭载于大众 ID. AURA T6，同时 HSD V2.1 即将推出，首发全场景倒车能力。
stories.analysis: 国产智驾芯片进入千万级交付规模，软件版本迭代开始绑定具体车型体验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 首发全场景倒车能力，体验再进一步

stories.title: InfoQ：Agent 开始调用基础设施，Kubernetes 准备好了吗？
stories.sourceTitle: Agent开始调用基础设施，Kubernetes准备好了吗？
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文文章讨论当 AI Agent 开始直接调用基础设施时，Kubernetes 需要做哪些准备。文章聚焦 Agent 与集群交互带来的新需求。
stories.analysis: Agent 从调用 API 走向操作集群，权限隔离与审计会成为落地的前置条件。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3Guard：面向 Token 流的实时安全护栏模型
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen3Guard 是 Qwen 家族首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 基础模型专门针对安全分类微调，并同步放出技术报告、GitHub、Hugging Face 与 ModelScope 资源。
stories.analysis: 开源安全护栏模型补齐了模型发布链条上的合规环节，也降低了自建审核的门槛。
